name: My Heart Belongs To You!
source:
It's the first day of senior high school! And Tine is absolutely terrified of going to school. She has to communicate with random strangers and make new friends again, she does NOT want to do that.

When she thought this was going to be hell, she saw someone, someone who can help her, someone who can look out for her, someone who can take care of her, someone who can love her.

It's now her mission to make this guy notice her, and potentially fall in love with her, as she fell in love with him.

"My heart belongs to you, but does your heart belongs to me?"

[from [url=https://wilt3rpv.itch.io/my-heart-belongs-to-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中开学第一天！Tine害怕去学校，怕得要命。她又得和陌生人交流，重新交朋友，而她一点也不想这么做。

就在她以为接下来会是地狱时，她看见了一个人。一个能够帮助她、照看她、呵护她、爱她的人。

现在，她的目标就是让这个男生注意到自己，甚至像自己爱上他一样，爱上自己。

“我的心属于你，可你的心属于我吗？”

[摘自[url=https://wilt3rpv.itch.io/my-heart-belongs-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
